description: Diagnostic daemon to analyze all 8 signals for discrimination quality. Queries mcp_signal_scores and counts distinct values per signal_type. Reports signals with <10 distinct values as WEAK per signal quality heuristic. Writes findings to signal_quality_log table via write_service. Heartbeat every 60s. Target weak signals: permission_scope, temporal_stability, tool_description_safety. Expose run() with if __name__ == '__main__' guard.
